metadata.title: Heroes of Dragon Age PvP events and rewards
metadata.scope: Recoverable named PvP and Onslaught event records. This is not a verified complete list of every event ever run.
metadata.freshness_rule: Latest dated record containing rewards for each normalized event name and format is retained in latest_events. Later name-only mentions do not erase known reward data. Older occurrences and their exact tiers remain separately dated.
metadata.format_rule: Ordinary timed PvP and Onslaught (guild tournament) versions are separate entries.
metadata.missing_data_rule: An empty reward field means the source did not document it; it never means that no reward existed.
metadata.rank_rule: Featured ranked rewards are not numerical rank assignments. Only explicitly documented rank cutoffs appear in rank_tiers.
metadata.date_rule: Scheduled dates are used where available. Original event-report dates are explicitly labelled. Archive capture dates are never used as event dates.
